song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: He alone is Bhairava, the world-bearing god;
in His own seeing's mirror stands the whole, mirrored by power.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam

verses.craft: Mirror-image kept whole (self-seeing mirror, power-mirrored); bearing-by-mirroring wonder.
verses.rejected: (a) mirror→glass → killed: vighna + load image. (b) explaining power-sole-agency → killed: NOTE prose, not song.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa adbhuta of world mirrored whole / L2+L3 voice
